newsitem.title: USA: Medical Manager to acquire four dealerships.
newsitem.headline: Medical Manager to acquire four dealerships.

text.p: Medical Manager Corp, which went public in January, said Monday it has signed definitive agreements to acquire by merger four of its independent dealerships.
The transactions will be accounted for as poolings of interests and are subject to various conditions, including completion of Medical Manager's due diligence review, it said.
The acquisitions are expected to close in April, it said.

The dealerships to be acquired had combined 1996 revenues of $9.0 million. They are Adaptive Health Systems of Washington Inc, Federal Way, Wash.; LSM Computing Inc, Somerville, N.J.; Specialized Systems Inc, Van Nuys, Calif.; and UNICO Inc, Evansville, Ind.
Medical Manager provides physicians with management system services.
